title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our office in Singapore, focusing on the deployment, testing, and real-world operation of L4 autonomous driving systems across international projects.

In this role, you will work at the frontline of autonomous driving deployment, collaborating closely with engineering teams, customers, and local partners to bring cutting-edge technology into real-world environments. You will play a critical role in ensuring that our systems operate safely, reliably, and effectively across diverse conditions.

You will also have opportunities to participate in global project deployments, gaining hands-on experience in different countries while contributing to the commercialization of autonomous driving technologies.

title: Global Technical Project Manager
description: We are seeking a skilled and passionate Project Manager to join our research and development center in Singapore, focusing on the deployment, testing, and operation of autonomous driving vehicles for Singapore launched projects. Here, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with top-notch engineers to explore cutting-edge autonomous driving technologies and translate them into commercial deployment and operations.
